record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.original_question: Is the Hilbert cube, equipped with its standard metric, Lipschitz countable dense homogeneous, meaning that for every epsilon > 0 and every two countable dense subsets A and B there is an epsilon-almost isometry h with h[A] = B?

evidence.quote: They call a metric spaces X Lipschitz countable dense homogeneous (Lipschitz-CDH) if given ε > 0 and A, B countable dense subsets of E there is an ε-almost isometry h such that h[A] = B.
Problem 29 (Dijkstra [18]). Is the Hilbert cube with its standard metric Lipschitz-CDH?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Equip the Hilbert cube $Q = \prod_{n=1}^{\infty} [0,1]$ with its standard metric $d(x,y) = \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} 2^{-n} |x_n - y_n|$. Given $\varepsilon > 0$, a bijection $h\colon (X,d) \to (X,d)$ between metric spaces is called an $\varepsilon$-almost isometry if $(1-\varepsilon)\, d(x,y) \le d(h(x), h(y)) \le (1+\varepsilon)\, d(x,y)$ for all $x,y \in X$. A metric space $(X,d)$ is said to be Lipschitz countable dense homogeneous (Lipschitz-CDH) if for every $\varepsilon > 0$ and every pair $A, B$ of countable dense subsets of $X$, there exists an $\varepsilon$-almost isometry $h\colon X \to X$ with $h[A] = B$.

Determine whether the Hilbert cube $(Q,d)$, with its standard metric as above, is Lipschitz-CDH.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returned related results on Lipschitz homogeneity and measure-preserving CDH of the Hilbert cube, but no source confirming a resolution of Dijkstra's specific question on Lipschitz-CDH (with $\varepsilon$-almost isometries) for the Hilbert cube with its standard metric. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneity properties with isometries and Lipschitz functions
status_evidence.snippet: Dijkstra's paper introducing Lipschitz-type homogeneity notions for metric spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Origin of the Lipschitz-CDH notion; no resolution of the Hilbert cube case is reported.

status_evidence.title: Measure-preserving countable dense homogeneity of the Hilbert cube
status_evidence.snippet: For any two countable dense subsets A,B of the Hilbert cube there is a homeomorphism mapping A to B that preserves product Lebesgue measure.
status_evidence.claim: Related variant (measure-preserving CDH) is solved positively, but this does not address Lipschitz-CDH.

status_evidence.title: Lipschitz homeomorphisms of the Hilbert cube
status_evidence.snippet: Lipschitz homogeneity of the Hilbert cube depends sensitively on the choice of metric.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the subtlety of Lipschitz-type properties for the Hilbert cube; no Lipschitz-CDH result for the standard metric is given.
